title: The Lion Pride
text: A pride of lions lies in the long grass by the only water for a day's march, gold among the gold, tails flicking. The old male lifts his scarred head and looks at you. Your waterskins are nearly empty.

options.label: Wait for them to drink and go, however long it takes.

outcomes.text: A thirsty afternoon in the sun, while they take their time.

options.label: Drive them off with fire. You need that water more than they do.

outcomes.text: They go, snarling, and you drink.

options.label: The quietest fills the skins under their very noses.

outcomes.text: Unseen, though the old male's ear twitched once.
